title: Literature threshold bank (4S-C)
summary: Curated illustrative literature-oriented thresholds aligned to FlahaSOIL wire keys and PRELIMINARY/MODERATE/ADVANCED test levels. DRAFT until human APPROVED. Never auto-updates FlahaSOIL. Entries are orientation notes for PA comparison — not product defaults.

entries.title: Soil pH band — many vegetables (literature orientation)
entries.bodyText: Common agronomy guidance places many vegetables near pH 6.0–7.0 for nutrient availability. Calcareous arid soils (QA/JO) often run higher — use region tags and local judgment.

entries.title: ECe general crop stress band (literature orientation)
entries.bodyText: Many field guides treat soil ECe rising toward ~2–4 dS/m as increasing salinity management pressure for sensitive crops. Method must be ECe (or converted); not interchangeable with 1:5 without context.

entries.title: Substrate EC tomato soilless upper note
entries.bodyText: Greenhouse tomato guides often flag substrate EC above ~2.5 dS/m as elevated risk depending on stage and cultivar. Not a FlahaSOIL product default.

entries.title: Organic matter floor — arid open-field orientation
entries.bodyText: Arid open-field systems often start with low OM; literature sometimes cites ~1–2% as a management floor to improve, not a universal optimum.

entries.title: Texture fraction sum integrity
entries.bodyText: Sand + silt + clay must equal 100% (±0.5) for valid USDA texture classification (FlahaSOIL engine rule).

structured.context: integrity rule for texture inputs; pair with silt/clay

entries.title: CEC buffering orientation (MODERATE+)
entries.bodyText: CEC interpretation is texture- and method-dependent. Illustrative moderate buffering often discussed around mid-teens cmol(+)/kg — not a crop yield model.

structured.context: orientation only; lab CEC preferred when available

entries.title: Exchangeable Na caution (MODERATE+)
entries.bodyText: Elevated exchangeable sodium on the complex raises sodicity concern; interpret with SAR/ESP at ADVANCED and with Ca/Mg balance.

structured.context: illustrative caution; not a universal cutoff

entries.title: Soil N orientation (MODERATE+)
entries.bodyText: Soil N is strongly method- and crop-dependent. Entry exists for bank completeness; always pair with method and crop demand.

entries.title: Soil P orientation (MODERATE+)
entries.bodyText: Phosphorus sufficiency bands vary by extract method (Olsen, Bray, Mehlich). Treat as placeholder for method-tagged literature.

entries.title: SAR caution (ADVANCED panel)
entries.bodyText: SAR is an ADVANCED-panel sodicity indicator. Literature cautions often appear near mid-single digits for structure risk; always interpret with ESP, EC, and texture.

entries.title: ESP caution (ADVANCED panel)
entries.bodyText: ESP above low teens often raises sodicity management discussion. ADVANCED evidence required in FlahaSOIL matrix.

structured.context: ADVANCED reports; pair with SAR and EC

entries.title: Irrigation water EC caution (not soil ECe)
entries.bodyText: Irrigation water EC is not soil ECe. Sensitive vegetables often need salinity-aware scheduling above ~1.5 dS/m water EC. Domain=irrigation_water.
